verdict.rationale: A recorded runtime probe shows the `phaser` npm package (v4.2.1) is MIT-licensed. The project's code is hosted publicly in the phaserjs/phaser GitHub repository, and the npm package ships readable source with TypeScript definitions, so the framework's source is readable under an open license. Missing for 10: first-party docs stating the license or how to read the source, and confirmation of the license's scope (e.g. whether the paid Editor and Game Agent tooling are also open)
